description.narrative: NextProtein is a company with a mission to produce insect-based protein for animal feed to accelerate sustainable agriculture and address feedstock and resource scarcity with close to no carbon footprint.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: We have committed to a EUR 7.35 million debt facility to nextProtein, a French-Tunisian company producing low-carbon, insect-based protein for animal feed. This investment was made through our Climate Innovation Facility in our Kinetic portfolio. It is part of a EUR 18 million Series B funding round, led by the SWEN Capital Blue Oceans Fund 2.The Series B funding will enable nextProtein to build its first full-scale production facility in Tunisia, boosting its annual production capacity and ensuring reliable supply of sustainable proteins and fats for the aquaculture, poultry and pet food industries. Our investment aims to demonstrate the commercial viability of nextProtein’s circular economy model at scale and to help accelerate the development of alternative proteins in global feed markets.
